information: Perfect pre-trip closure notice; no transport or model latency, no semantic auditor. Only exposed trips with lane-feasible alternatives can divert.
compliance: Stable SHA256 city/seed/vehicle uniform draw; nested threshold, shared across arms.

retention: Retain all preflight exclusions and unavailable alternative routes; do not replace demand
